property.name: isRing
property.label: Use Ring Layout
property.description: Toggles the style of progress indicator used. If true, switches to the progress ring instead of the default progress bar.

property.name: isCurrency
property.label: Is Currency
property.description: If true, formats the amounts as a currency.

property.name: color
property.label: Color
property.description: Color of the progress indicator. You can enter a color name, like 'Red' or 'Green', or a Hex Color Code, like '#32a852'.
